title: Gate KANBUS_TEST_* and *_for_testing out of release builds
description: From kbs-bbf2a6. 42 KANBUS_TEST_* variables (25 Rust, 17 Python) and ten *_for_testing functions change behaviour in release builds (for example KANBUS_TEST_INVALID_STATUS makes every status validation fail), and PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST disables the daemon in issue_files.py. Gate Rust hooks behind cfg(test) or the test-hooks feature, and Python behind the existing KANBUS_ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS gate or fixtures, injecting failures through traits or step-library fixtures. Update docs/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md. Acceptance: a release kbs binary ignores every KANBUS_TEST_* variable (test), and Python ignores them unless the test gate is on.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: PR #549 merged with CI green. Remaining ungated test behaviour (Rust daemon client overrides and *_for_testing helpers, daemon_server handle_request_for_testing) now compiles only under cfg(test) or the test-hooks feature; Python's PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST switch replaced by the gated KANBUS_TEST_DISABLE_SERVICE hook. tools/check_test_switch_gating.py in CI blocks ungated reads. Release kbs with KANBUS_TEST_INVALID_STATUS=1 behaves normally; the name is absent from the binary.
